headline: Deadlands Fighting Quickens While Lykos Isle Flares Anew
war_summary: Since our last edition the weight of the fighting has shifted to the Deadlands, where three base events have fallen within the past two hours, the latest but an hour old; the day's toll of 14,008 Colonial and 18,740 Warden casualties now climbs at the war's steepest Warden rate, with its eleven works standing seven Colonial to four. Fishermen's Row, busiest at our previous filing, has gone silent these three hours, yet its casualty rate still accelerates and its nine works remain seven Warden to two Colonial. Lykos Isle emerges as a fresh flashpoint, two events inside two hours, the latest under one, its seven works split four Warden to three Colonial. The Weathered Expanse retains the heaviest day's exchange at some 35,000 casualties, Colonial fire accelerating while Warden rates waver from hour to hour. Kings Cage has logged no base events since yesterday evening, though its day's losses pass twelve thousand and Warden losses rise sharply. Linn Mercy's fifteen events all lie nine hours back and its front cools. Elsewhere the lines hold quiet: sixty-eight days of war, thirty-four victory towns the prize, and no victor declared.
